candidates.title: Spec text should quote user-visible strings from source verbatim

evidence.quote: That path prints `No active unresolved threads found.` and exits 0

proposedChange.change: When a spec references a user-visible string, require the draft to quote it verbatim from source (or explicitly mark it as a paraphrase); the shipped script prints `No active unresolved review threads found.`

candidates.title: Spec registration should not silently flip `source` to local

evidence.quote: const args = { source: 'local', force: false, json: false };

proposedChange.change: Preserve a non-empty frontmatter `source` when --source is not explicitly passed, instead of overwriting a GitHub/ADO-sourced spec with `local`.

candidates.title: Document NODE_OPTIONS backslash stripping for Windows preload paths

evidence.quote: Forward slashes keep Node's NODE_OPTIONS tokenizer from eating Windows backslashes.

proposedChange.change: Note that NODE_OPTIONS drops backslashes, so Windows `--require`/preload paths must use forward slashes.
